subject: Mutual Action Plan (MAP) Draft — Integration Build Plan (SDK, streaming, tool-calling)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0500
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (integration milestone focus)

Hi Alex / Sophie —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery/demo and the MAP items we discussed focusing on the integration build phase:

- Goal: Production integration of Redwood inference into ACME's customer support flow (SDK + streaming responses + tool-calling for backend lookups)
- Target close / go-live window: pilot by end of Q2 2027 (target: 2027-06-30)

Attached is a first-pass MAP spreadsheet (MAP_v1.xlsx) with milestone suggestions. High-level milestones we agreed on:
1) Integration spec & API mapping (ACME owner: Sophie) — define endpoints, required structured outputs, auth flow.
2) SDK integration (Redwood SDK + ACME app) — initial PoC and error handling.
3) Streaming & latency SLOs — test harness and perf targets.
4) Tool-calling & backend connector (for order lookups) — contract for tool inputs/outputs.
5) QA & evals — prompt sets, regression criteria, rollout plan.

Next steps (proposed):
- Sophie to confirm owners and any missing dependencies by Tue 23 Feb
- Ben to share MAP_v1 and schedule a 30-min sync with engineering to assign Redwood owners
- Marissa to own integration engineering follow-up and provide estimated effort by Thu 25 Feb

Please review the attached MAP_v1 and let me know any edits. I’ll circulate an updated version after your inputs.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
Schedule: https://cal.com/ben-redwood/30
Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 3 tabs: milestones, owners, risks)
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP draft (integration milestone focus)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP draft. Sophie and I reviewed this internally. A few quick clarifications:

- Target close: ACME is aligned on pilot by 30 Jun, but we need legal review on data retention (SOC2 requirements) — legal lead will sign off by 15 Mar.
- Milestone 1 (Integration spec): we'll own defining customer-facing fields; can Redwood provide schema examples for structured outputs?
- Tool-calling: we will need a fail-open fallback for order lookups during incidents.

Sophie will confirm internal owners and dependencies by Tue 23 Feb as requested. Also attaching our internal integration spec doc for reference.

Appreciate it —
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product, ACME Corp
Attachment: acme_integration_notes.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 08:22:00 -0500
Subject: MAP_v1 — Engineering owners and estimated effort

Hi all —

Following Ben's note and Alex's clarifications, I reviewed the MAP_v1 and sketched owners + initial effort estimates for the integration build milestone:

Milestone: Integration spec & API mapping
Owner: Sophie (ACME) / Marissa (Redwood PM)
ETA for spec: 2 weeks (2027-03-11)
Dependencies: ACME schema doc, auth token exchange details

Milestone: SDK integration (PoC)
Owner: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood Eng)
ETA: 3 sprints (~5 weeks) for PoC integration + retries/error handling
Dependencies: SDK packaging, sample dataset, streaming client example

Milestone: Streaming & latency SLOs
Owner: Vivek Kulkarni
ETA: parallel to SDK work, perf harness ready in 3 weeks
Dependencies: perf metrics, target p95 latency, token rate expectations

Milestone: Tool-calling (order lookup connector)
Owner: ACME backend lead (TBD) / Redwood Eng (support)
ETA: 4 weeks after spec finalization
Dependencies: API contract, sandbox creds, fallback behavior defined

Milestone: QA & evals (prompt sets, regressions)
Owner: Marissa (Redwood PM) / Sophie (ACME)
ETA: ongoing — initial eval suite in 2 weeks after PoC

I’ve attached an updated MAP_v1 that includes owners and proposed milestone dates (MAP_v1.xlsx). Vivek, can you confirm the SDK integration estimate is realistic given the streaming + tool-calling scope? If needed, we’ll break the PoC into an incremental deliverable (SDK + basic streaming) to hit the pilot date.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Manager, Integrations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (owners tab updated)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sophie Lee <sophie.lee@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: Re: MAP_v1 — Engineering owners and estimated effort

Thanks Marissa — quick confirmations from engineering:

- SDK integration PoC: agree with ~5 weeks to have a stable PoC that supports streaming + basic tool-calling (order lookup). We can deliver an incremental artifact at the 3-week mark: SDK samples + streaming demo.
- Risk: order lookup connector dependency on ACME sandbox creds could add a week if there are auth changes. Please provision sandbox API keys as early as possible.
- Action items for Redwood eng: create streaming client example repo, provide structured output schema examples, and a sample prompt set for evals.

We’ll sync with Sophie on the auth flow and sandbox timeline.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Staff Engineer | Redwood Inference
